_comment_play_time: 24-hour HH:MM, local time. Edit this and restart the service (sudo systemctl restart kahf-chromecast) to change the time.
_comment_days: 0=Mon .. 6=Sun. Runs every day by default. For the Friday sunnah only, use [4].
_comment_port: Must differ from azan-chromecast's port (default 8000) if both run on the same machine.
